entities.name: Kethek
entities.description: A merciless Phyrexian goliath general on New Phyrexia, created by Urabrask and Sheoldred, who melts enemies with flamethrowers and reforges them as cannon fodder.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian who rebelled against Elesh Norn and made allies with Sheoldred.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A ruthless Phyrexian, ally of Urabrask in his rebellion.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler against whom Urabrask rebelled.

events.summary: Urabrask and Sheoldred, as a gesture of goodwill, work together to create Kethek as a general to lead their united front.
events.quote: these allies worked together to create a new Phyrexian general to lead their united front

relations.note: They are allies in the rebellion.
